blocks.text: PV cells ke kaam ka bunyadi usool photovoltaic effect hai: roshni parne par kisi material mein voltage aur electric current paida hona. Photovoltaic effect mein photons (roshni ke zarron) ki energy se semiconductor ke electrons valence band se conduction band mein chale jate hain (excite hote hain). PN junction is process ko behtar banata hai: yeh electrons aur holes ko alag kar deta hai, jis se voltage banta hai jo electric current chalata hai.

blocks.prompt: Solar cell mein PN junction kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Roshni electrons ko excite karti hai, lekin junction na ho to electrons wapas holes se mil jate. PN junction ka andaroni electric field electrons ko ek taraf aur holes ko doosri taraf dhakelta hai, is liye voltage aur current milta hai.

items: Photovoltaic effect: photons semiconductor ke electrons ko valence band se conduction band mein bhejte hain; PN junction electrons aur holes alag kar ke voltage aur current deta hai.
